cands.name: Dante Sanchez Sanchez
cands.bio: Air Force Reserve veteran and electrical contractor; born in the Dominican Republic, immigrated in 2005; founder of Trypower Electrical Services (water and wastewater infrastructure). Describes himself as a moderate Democrat; first run for office.
cands.local_ties: Hillsborough County (DOE filing county). Active with the Dominican Association of Tampa per his campaign site.

record.text: No elected office. First entered the cycle running in HD 64 before moving to HD 66. Platform: teacher pay, school facility oversight, roads, drainage, street lighting, home-hardening help to lower insurance premiums.

money_notes.text: Through Oct. 2: over $11,000 in contributions plus nearly $10,000 in personal loans (about $21,000 total); about $8,000 on hand.

cands.gaps: No endorsements, photo or editorial coverage found beyond the Florida Politics race profile. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.

cands.name: Traci Koster
cands.bio: Republican family lawyer first elected to the House in 2020; chairs the Civil Justice & Claims Subcommittee and is Vice Chair of the Justice Budget Subcommittee. Former president of the Hillsborough County Bar Association Young Lawyers Division; helped found Tampa Bay Pro Bono Partners.
cands.local_ties: Hillsborough County family lawyer and Hillsborough Bar leader (Florida Politics).

record.text: 2025: led repeal of Florida's 'clean hands' restriction on compensation for the wrongfully imprisoned (after four sessions); sponsored a signed measure on oversight of the organizations coordinating publicly funded mental health/substance abuse services. 2023: school-zone speed camera law.

money_notes.text: Through Oct. 16: about $167,000 raised, about $117,000 on hand, plus about $46,000 in-kind from the Florida House Republican Campaign Committee and Republican Party of Florida. Her committee Friends of Traci Koster has raised more than $2.1 million since 2021 with about $1.2 million on hand (business, healthcare and utility donors).

endorsements.text: Associated Industries of Florida; Chief Executive Officers of Management Companies.

cands.gaps: No newspaper endorsement found. No controversies found. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) was NOT run: the shared web-search budget was exhausted, so no owner-source status is known.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).
